description: Echo's check on a piece of code you've written or are about to write: colours, spacing, radii, shadows and timing off Echo's scales, raw elements where Echo has the component, props a component doesn't take, controls without a name, markup a keyboard or screen reader can't use, restyling Echo from outside, and the screen rules one file can show. The same rules as `npx echo-ui-cli check`, which runs on a whole project with its own theme; this one uses the default theme. Each finding says the Echo way to fix it.

code.description: The file's contents: TSX, JSX or CSS, up to 200,000 characters.

file.description: Its file name, e.g. "app/settings/page.tsx" or "styles.css", which says what it is. TSX when left out.

name: check_code
title: Check code against Echo
